claims.assertion: Yazhi describes Earth as an isolated dome or Matrix with rules of reality distinct from outside worlds.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She presents this as her account of Earth’s separation.

claims.assertion: Yazhi says Earth experiences and values carried by incarnating people influence Federation decisions about Earth.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She says this feedback may perpetuate the same rules and problems.

claims.assertion: Swaruu X says the Federation limits public access to advanced technology to preserve the Earth experience chosen by souls.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X
claims.qualifiers: She describes multiple civilization tiers with different technologies.
